lessons.key: surviving_mutant::vec0 virtual tables sqlite vec reject fts5 style delete trigger command syntax use plain delete from vec table where rowid old rowid instead triggers on catalog fts fts5 keep delete syntax because they target fts5 not vec0
lessons.text: vec0 virtual tables (sqlite-vec) reject FTS5-style ('delete', ...) trigger command syntax; use plain 'DELETE FROM vec_table WHERE rowid = old.rowid' instead. Triggers on catalog_fts (FTS5) keep ('delete', ...) syntax because they target FTS5 not vec0.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::windows ebusy eperm eacces retry with backoff pattern 50ms 1000ms 25 attempts is required when renaming model files that concurrent test files e g embedder test mjs may hold open reusable for any windows ci that touches onnx model sentinel files
lessons.text: Windows EBUSY/EPERM/EACCES retry-with-backoff pattern (50ms→1000ms, 25 attempts) is required when renaming model files that concurrent test files (e.g. embedder.test.mjs) may hold open. Reusable for any Windows CI that touches ONNX/model/sentinel files.

lessons.key: spec_deviation::when deleting cli modules e g src catalog cli ts the package json scripts block must be updated in the same task otherwise npm run old cli name stays broken across phases phase 1 1 t 01 deleted cli ts without redirect phase 1 4 t 14 had to redirect catalog load to build index ts to repair
lessons.text: When deleting CLI modules (e.g. src/catalog/cli.ts) the package.json scripts block must be updated in the same task — otherwise npm run <old-cli-name> stays broken across phases. Phase 1.1 T-01 deleted cli.ts without redirect; Phase 1.4 T-14 had to redirect catalog:load to build-index.ts to repair.

lessons.key: spec_deviation::d 001 cross check needs 2 axis classification stale section refs 18 5 pointing to deleted 18 are fail meta documentation of the d 001 rule itself e g zero 18 x refs is keep grep hits must be classified before marking as drift
lessons.text: D-001 cross-check needs 2-axis classification: stale section refs (§18.5 pointing to deleted §18) are FAIL; META documentation of the D-001 rule itself (e.g. 'ZERO §18.x refs') is keep. Grep hits must be classified before marking as drift.

lessons.key: spec_deviation::implementer true observation wrong reason pattern implementer correctly observed memory studio 0 0 0 build index node experimental strip types no warnings scripts build index ts exit 2 but misattributed to config catalog has 0 items actual cause idempotent rerun exit contract verifier must audit reasoning and observation not just trust either
lessons.text:
Implementer 'true observation, wrong reason' pattern: Implementer correctly observed 
> memory-studio@0.0.0 build-index
> node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings scripts/build-index.ts exit 2 but misattributed to 'config/catalog has 0 items' (actual cause: idempotent rerun exit contract). Verifier must audit reasoning AND observation, not just trust either.

lessons.key: spec_deviation::dispatch orchestrator s prompt assertions about expected exit code output can themselves be wrong orchestrator must read actual implementation contract e g in scripts build index ts before claiming expected x to sub agents verifier re verifies but introducing false expectations wastes tokens
lessons.text: Dispatch (orchestrator's prompt) assertions about expected exit code/output can themselves be wrong — orchestrator must read actual implementation contract (e.g.  in scripts/build-index.ts) before claiming 'expected: X' to sub-agents. Verifier re-verifies, but introducing false expectations wastes tokens.
